home.faqAfterTitle: If anything is still unclear, write to us. We reply in under 24 hours.

faq.a: Specialised departments that execute real work for your business. You can activate Marketing or SEO today. Each department proposes, executes and monitors under your rules.

faq.q: Does it work on its own or need me to tell it what to do?
faq.a: You set the goals and the rules. The department researches, drafts and proposes. When an important action needs approval, it asks you before acting.

faq.q: Does it work around the clock?
faq.a: Yes. Your business never stops and neither do your departments. They monitor what matters and flag when a decision is needed.

faq.q: Which tools does it work with?
faq.a: Email, calendar, CRM, Drive, social media, spreadsheets, design tools. It works with the ones your business already uses.

faq.q: Do I need to know tech?
faq.a: No. If you can use email and a calendar, you can use Departify. There's nothing to install or configure.
Always. You decide what it can do alone, what needs your approval, and what's blocked. Change the limits whenever you want.

faq.q: Does each business get its own space?
faq.a: Yes. Your instance is private: separate data, its own memory, its own credentials. Nothing mixes with other customers.

faq.q: What happens to my data if I leave?
faq.a: You have 30 days to download everything. After that, the instance and associated data are deleted. No commitments, no fine print.
Monthly activation from €99 per department. Cancel whenever you want. We'll tell you the exact cost before you confirm.

faq.q: Can I start with just one department?
faq.a: Yes. Start with Marketing or SEO and add more departments as you need them. Each one works in coordination with the others.
No. It's a team with leadership, members, memory, tasks and deliverables. The difference is that it proposes and executes, it doesn't just reply.

faq.q: Do I need to approve everything?
faq.a: Only what matters. The department drafts and executes when you approve. The routine work it does on its own under your rules.

precios.metaDescription: Three plans to bring AI departments into your business. No surprises, cancel whenever you want.
precios.ogDescription: Three plans to bring AI departments into your business. Monthly or annual, no commitment.

hero.title: Three plans. No surprises. Cancel whenever you want.
hero.subtitle: Start with one department, add more when you need them. Every plan includes a private instance, guided onboarding, and approvals on every sensitive action.

items.question: Can I change plans at any time?
items.answer: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade from the admin panel. The change takes effect immediately and is prorated on your next invoice.

items.question: What's included in the monthly usage?
items.answer: Each plan includes a monthly usage tier sized to a typical team's scope. If you need more capacity, you can top up with extra credits without changing plans.

items.question: Is there a commitment?
items.answer: No. Every plan is monthly or annual with no commitment. If you decide to cancel, you keep access for 30 days to export everything.

items.question: Do I need a card to start?
items.answer: No. You can kick off the sign-up flow, complete the onboarding, and explore the dashboard. We'll ask for a payment method when you're ready to activate your first department.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Credit and debit cards, bank transfer for annual plans, and SEPA for European companies. Automatic invoicing available.

items.question: Do you issue invoices?
items.answer: Yes. We issue an automatic invoice on every charge. European businesses can share their VAT number for validation.

privacidad.title: Privacy policy
privacidad.description: How we collect, process and protect the personal data of the people who use Departify.

sections.title: Data controller
sections.beforeStrong: The data controller for the personal data collected through this website and the associated services is
sections.afterStrong: (hereinafter, "Departify"), based in Spain with tax ID B-00000000.
sections.beforeEmail: For any privacy-related matter, you can write to

sections.title: Data we process
sections.intro: Departify processes the following categories of personal data, depending on how you interact with the platform:
list: Operational data: configuration, contracted departments, mission history.
Usage data: panel interactions, aggregated metrics.
End-customer data: information that the client business chooses to connect to the platform, under its own responsibility.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: We process the data to deliver the contracted service, keep the platform secure, improve the product, meet legal obligations and — where applicable — send commercial communications that the user has authorised.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.body: The legal basis for processing is the performance of the service agreement, compliance with legal obligations, the data subject's consent and — where applicable — the legitimate interest in keeping the service secure.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: Data is kept for the duration of the contractual relationship and, afterwards, for the period required by law to address any potential liabilities. Operational data can be deleted at the client's request at any time.

sections.title: Processors
sections.body: Departify works with infrastructure, analytics and customer-support providers that may process data on behalf of the platform. All providers sign data-processing agreements in line with the GDPR.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.beforeEmail: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and data portability at any time by writing to
sections.afterEmail: . You may also lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data, including encryption in transit and at rest, access control, activity logs and periodic risk assessments. You can find more details on the security page.

seguridad.metaDescription: Your private instance, your credentials, your memory. How we protect your company's data.
seguridad.ogDescription: A private instance per customer, your own encryption keys, permissions per action. How we protect your data.

hero.title: Your business doesn't share a digital office with anyone.
hero.subtitle: Each customer runs on a private instance, with its own credentials, independent memory and auditable permissions.

pillars.title: Independent instance
pillars.description: Each customer runs on an instance with dedicated resources. No infrastructure is shared with other customers.

pillars.title: Separated data
pillars.description: Each company has its own database and perimeter. Data is never mixed between customers.

pillars.title: Your own credentials
pillars.description: Encryption keys are unique per instance. If you decide to leave, you can disconnect and export everything.

pillars.title: Permissions per action
pillars.description: Every action is classified into three levels: can, must approve, never. Your team enforces them.

pillars.title: Activity logs
pillars.description: Every action — executed, proposed or approved — is recorded. Visible to your admin team.

pillars.title: Administrative access
pillars.description: Only the people you invite can view and approve. Roles are split between administrators and members.

pillars.title: Reversible integrations
pillars.description: You can disconnect any integration whenever you want. Previously read data is deleted on request.

pillars.title: Deletion on cancellation
pillars.description: You have 30 days to reactivate or export. After that, the data tied to the instance is deleted.

isolation.title: Different companies, different instances.
isolation.body: Each company keeps its own instance, with its keys, its database and its perimeter. Information never crosses over.

cookies.metaDescription: How Departify uses cookies and how you can manage them.
cookies.ogDescription: How Departify uses cookies and how you can manage them.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Clear information about the cookies Departify uses and how to manage them.

whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.body: Cookies are small files that a website stores on your device to remember information between visits. We use them so Departify works correctly and so we can understand how the site is used.

cookiesWeUse.title: Cookies we use
cookiesWeUse.intro: We use three types of cookies, always with the goal of improving your experience:

technical.label: Technical
technical.body: Required for the site and your session to work. These cannot be disabled.

preference.label: Preference
preference.body: Remember your language and other display options so you don't have to set them on every visit.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.body: Help us understand which parts of the site are used most. The data is aggregated and never identifies the visitor individually.

management.title: Managing cookies
management.body: You can delete or block cookies from your browser settings. Note that blocking certain cookies may affect how the site works.

thirdParty.title: Third parties
thirdParty.body: Some analytics or support services may set their own cookies. Those third parties have their own privacy and cookie policies.

updates.title: Updates
updates.body: We may update this policy to reflect technical or legal changes. We will publish the updated version on this same page.

terminos.metaDescription: Conditions that govern the use of Departify.
terminos.ogDescription: Conditions that govern the use of Departify.
terminos.title: Terms of service
terminos.description: The conditions that govern access to and use of Departify by companies and professionals.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: By contracting or using Departify you accept these terms. If you act on behalf of a company, you confirm you have the authority to bind it.

object.title: Subject matter
object.body: Departify provides AI-powered department operations services, accessible from the web dashboard and from Telegram, with a private instance per customer.

account.title: Registration and account
account.body: You need an account to use the service. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity under your account.

allowedUse.title: Acceptable use
allowedUse.body: You agree to use the service in compliance with the law, not to use the outputs for illicit activity, and to respect the rights of third parties. Bypassing security measures or reverse-engineering the product is prohibited.

payments.title: Plans and payments
payments.body: Pricing and conditions for each plan are listed on the pricing page. Charges are made in advance. You can change or cancel your plan at any time from the admin dashboard.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: Departify retains all rights to the software, brand, designs and site materials. The customer retains ownership of the content they upload or generate through the service.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: Departify will not be liable for indirect damages, lost profits or data loss arising from use of the service beyond what is required by law. The platform is an operational support tool; strategic and legally relevant decisions remain the customer's responsibility.

suspension.title: Suspension and termination
suspension.body: We may suspend the service if we detect misuse, security risk or non-payment. You can cancel at any time and keep access to your instance for 30 days to export your data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may modify these terms. We will notify you at least 30 days before substantial changes take effect. Continued use of the service implies acceptance of the new terms.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by applicable Spanish and European law. For any dispute, the parties submit to the courts of the customer's city, without prejudice to consumer rights.
